''''Spires'''' is a piece of [[furniture]] that hangs on a wall. It can rotate into daily stock at the [[Carpenter's Shop]] for {{Price|800}} or the [[Traveling Cart]] for between {{Tprice|furniture}}.  

It can also be purchased in the [[Casino]] for {{Price|3000|Qi}} or from the [[Furniture Catalogue]] for {{Price|0}}.
